deploy-bot: 🚀 Staging deploy started
- env: staging
- deploy_id: db3f7a2b
- tag: v2.14.0-rc5
- commit: 9f3c2b7 (feat/reranker-stability)
- targets: frontend, inference-runtime, orchestrator, batch-scheduler
- change window: 03:00-05:00 UTC
- CI: <https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9876|build-9876>
ETA canary: ~8m. Will post progress updates.

maria: ack — watching smoke tests and dashboards. Will pin traffic if p95 regresses. :eyes:

jun: quick question — does this tag include DB migration `20260318_12_add_reranker_idx`?

alex: yes, included. migration is in release jobset and runs after orchestrator is rolled.

tara: kicking off smoke checks against canary endpoints: `/health`, `/generate`, `/rerank`. I'll paste failures.

deploy-bot: canary progress: 10% -> 30% (2m elapsed)
- frontend: healthy
- orchestrator: healthy
- inference-runtime: 88/100 health; p95 latency +20% vs baseline

maria: seeing same on dashboards. Can we apply a fallback to the previous quantized profile while we investigate?

jun: per runbook, on >15% p95 regression we should hold and shift traffic to compatible variant. Applying temporary split: inference-runtime canary -> `v2.13.9-quant` 80%, rc5 20%.

alex: applying traffic command:
``
./deployctl traffic --svc inference-runtime --env staging --split "v2.13.9-quant=80,v2.14.0-rc5=20" --reason "p95 regression"
```

deploy-bot: traffic split applied. Metrics show p95 trending toward baseline.

tara: smoke results: earlier rerank had ~3 fails, now 0. `/generate` and `/health` pass for both variants.

maria: leaving canary pinned to `v2.13.9-quant` for remainder of change window. Please collect traces and evals for the failing prompts.

jun: ticket opened: <https://issues.redwood/internal/RED-4123|RED-4123> — will collect perf traces, KV cache metrics, and compare branch differences.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy finished
- deploy_id: db3f7a2b
- result: partial-rollout
- details: frontend & orchestrator rolled; inference-runtime pinned to `v2.13.9-quant` due to perf regression
- duration: 12m
- artifacts: <https://artifacts.redwood/internal/releases/db3f7a2b|release-artifacts>
- note: no DB rollback needed; migration was noop on staging

maria: adding short note in release tracker and tagging SRE for trace retention.

jun: will keep monitoring overnight and coordinate full rollout after RED-4123 triage.

alex: thanks team — follow-up PR for perf instrumentation incoming.
